subject: PO issuance & line-item corrections for Lumenix onboarding
messages:
From: Megan Li <megan.li@lumenix.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Theo Santos <theo.santos@lumenix.com>, procurement@lumenix.com
Date: 2027-06-29T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lumenix onboarding — missing PO reference and spend cap mismatch

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding earlier. I attached our completed onboarding form and the initial invoice file. When we tried to match the provisional PO you issued this morning (PO #784312) against our invoice, the spend cap in Redwood's system shows $75,000 but our contract schedule lists the initial committed bucket as $125,000. Can you confirm which cap applies while the procurement paperwork finalizes?

Also, the invoice line items were aggregated under a single SKU on your provisional PO; for audit reasons we'd like them broken out into three lines (Compute, Storage, Support) with the cost splits shown on the attached spreadsheet. If you need any additional vendor IDs or tax forms I can get them over today.

Attachments: Lumenix_Onboarding_Form.pdf (form), Lumenix_Invoice_June.pdf (invoice), lineitems_request.xlsx (requested splits)

Best,
Megan Li
Head of Procurement — Lumenix
megan.li@lumenix.com
+1 415 555 0143
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@lumenix.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenix onboarding — missing PO reference and spend cap mismatch

Hi Megan — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers:

- We issued provisional PO #784312 this morning from the onboarding pipeline; that provisional cap is a temporary guardrail at $75,000 while the legal/finance review runs.
- If the signed contract shows $125k committed, we will raise the provisional cap immediately once we have the signed PO/contract scanned into our procurement ticket.
- We can update the PO to split the aggregated SKU into three line items; I've copied Connor from onboarding to coordinate the split and ensure the ledger codes map correctly.

Connor — can you confirm you can take the attached lineitems_request.xlsx and issue an amended provisional PO with the three lines (Compute, Storage, Support) and add Lumenix's vendor tax id to the PO metadata? If you need the signed contract, Megan will upload it to the Drive link in the ticket.

I'll leave the technical mapping to you — priority is to make Lumenix able to get invoices paid on schedule.

Best,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Megan Li <megan.li@lumenix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenix onboarding — missing PO reference and spend cap mismatch

Megan / Monica — I'm on it. I reviewed the onboarding form and the invoice. Two quick items:

1) Vendor tax ID is present on the attached onboarding form (line 4). I will copy that into PO metadata.
2) For accounting classification we need the three cost centers your team wants mapped (I placed three placeholder ledger tags in the sheet). Please confirm: Compute -> CC-7001, Storage -> CC-7009, Support -> CC-7012. If that mapping is correct, I'll create an amended provisional PO (784312-A) with three line items and the requested dollar splits: Compute $68,000 / Storage $42,000 / Support $15,000 = $125,000.

Note: creating a provisional PO at $125,000 will temporarily lift the cap in the provisioning system; Finance approval (Rishi) will still be required for any spend above $100k for a new vendor. Tagging Rishi for the approval path.

Attachments: provisional_PO_784312.pdf (current), lineitems_corrections_sheet.xlsx

Connor O'Brien
Onboarding Operations — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Li <megan.li@lumenix.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenix onboarding — missing PO reference and spend cap mismatch

Thanks Connor — quick finance note from my side:

- I approve raising the provisional PO cap to $125,000 for Lumenix conditional on receipt of the signed contract PDF and a submitted vendor W-9 (or regional equivalent).
- For audit trail, please create a Jira ticket under PROC-8421 with the link to the contract and tag me as approver.
- I'll enter a temporary payment authority so AP can process up to $125k while we complete vendor credit checks. Any invoices beyond that will require a secondary sign-off.

Megan — once you upload the signed contract and tax documentation to the Drive link in the ticket, Connor and Monica should be able to finalize the amended provisional PO and the line-item breakup.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@lumenix.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumenix onboarding — missing PO reference and spend cap mismatch

Megan — thanks. I created the Jira ticket and uploaded the amended provisional PO (784312-A) with discrete line items and ledger codes (see link). I also added a short note describing the temporary cap lift to $125,000 pending Finance verification. Steps next: 

- Megan: please upload signed contract PDF and tax form to the Drive folder and paste the link in PROC-8421 thread.
- Connor: after verifying the contract, please mark the PO status as AMENDED and attach provisional_PO_784312-A.pdf to the ticket (for AP).
- Rishi: once you confirm the documents are present, please toggle the temporary payment authority so AP can accept vendor invoices up to $125k.

I've attached the amended PO and the lineitem corrections sheet for your review.

Attachments: provisional_PO_784312-A.pdf, lineitems_corrections_sheet.xlsx

Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
